_comment: Whistle per-tensor tolerances for compare_tensors.py (finalized, Stage 4, 2026-10-09).
Correctness regime: ref-dtype GGUF (models/whistle/whistle-F32.gguf, all F32), --backend cpu --threads 1,
C++ F32 compute; decoder caches F32 (the family has no F16 KV path); C++ log-mel frontend (no mel injection).
Recipe: finalized = max(1.5 x observed, magnitude budget (1e-4 x p99_abs / 1e-5 x rms), 1e-6), observed and
magnitudes = max over the 4 manifest cases (jfk, fleurs-de, fleurs-fr, fleurs-es). _observed_* / _magnitude_*
record the inputs.
Two reference sources (user decision 2026-10-09):
enc.final            = the closed Needle engine (needle_embed). The engine runs 8-bit activations / int8 KV
(QAT targets); weights are bit-identical (dequantized CQ). WIDENED ~3000x vs the
magnitude budget: dominant drift is the engine's activation quantization, not the port.
Evidence: the float64 reference model shows the same gap vs the engine (median
per-frame cos 0.9999, abs median ~4.5e-3), and C++ matches the reference model's
enc.final to 6.6e-6 max abs on jfk. Largest errors sit on the first/last frames.
everything else      = the float64 numpy reference model (scripts/lib/whistle_ref.py), matched to the
engine by probing. Drift is F32-vs-F64 accumulation; all within the magnitude budget
(no widening). enc.blk.<i>.out = mHC lane mean after layer i, values reach ~2e4 on one
outlier channel (429), relative error ~5e-7.
enc.mel.in is computed (not injected) on both sides; double-precision host FFT on both, drift ~1e-10.
dec.logits_raw.gen8: logits after <s><|lang|> + 8 text tokens, teacher-forced on the reference model's greedy
tokens (C++ teacher-forces its beam hypothesis; identical first 8 tokens on all 4 cases).
